Sara (Partnerships): Quick sync — SI launch next Wed. Need final SEV hotline scripting + who opens war room. Proposed: shared channel #partner-nova-sev, pre-join: James, Alex, Meera, Partner L1. Any objections?

Meera (Customer Success): +1. Please add escalation order: partner L1 -> Redwood partner-ops -> SRE-oncall -> Eng lead. L1 to ping via shared channel first, then open war room if >10 mins unresolved. Also request: include partner's dedicated Slack handle and their oncall number in the channel topic.

James (SRE-oncall): I can be primary first 48h post-launch. Can we pre-authorize PartnerBot to open a bridge with `/open-bridge --label partner-nova`? If we hit latency/regressions escalate to eng-runtime. Quick runbook snippet below (for the shared channel pinned message):
```
1) Partner L1 posts incident with short title + customer-id
2) PartnerOps pings @James (SRE-oncall)
3) If not ack in 5m or error class == SEV1 -> PartnerOps runs `/open-bridge --label partner-nova`
4) SRE triages, if memory/cuda -> escalate to @Alex (Solutions Eng) and tag `eng-runtime`
```

Alex (Solutions Eng): Add me to pre-authorized list. Also recommend a fallback model variant and routing policy in the channel topic so we can failover to cheaper instance before scaling. I'll draft a 1-paragraph fallback script.

Sara (Partnerships): Perfect. Action items: Meera update channel topic with partner handle + oncall -> today EOD. James add PartnerBot command to ops playbook -> tomorrow AM. Alex draft fallback script -> tomorrow noon. We'll run a 15-min dry run Friday 10:30 PT. @PartnerBot please create shared channel now when ready :thumbsup:

PartnerBot: channel #partner-nova-sev created by @Sara. Bridge template `partner-nova` added. Reminders set for dry run Friday 10:30 PT.
